findings: Results toolbar labels size-based marking correctly as By Size / Keep Largest / Keep Smallest. This narrows the earlier v10 label finding to MarkingCriteria Description metadata used by completion messages, not the actual toolbar labels.

Results-grid Delete key invokes DelistCommand, removing list entries, rather than DeleteMarkedFilesCommand. Physical deletion is exposed separately by the explicitly labelled Delete Marked Files button.
Space passes selected item and selected items through MultiCommandParameterConverter into marking commands; Enter opens selection and double-tap opens selected item. Native/UI runtime not exercised.
Result grid disables user sorting, retaining grouping order. Deleted state adds strike-through and theme foreground; these remain presentation of cached existence state, not fresh equality evidence.

Preview toggle changes ShowPreview and pane width; selected-item binding remains active on the results grid, consistent with the previously reviewed preview-decoding path still running when the pane is hidden.
